data.desc: Blend Labs, Inc. (NYSE: BLND) is a leading digital banking platform that helps financial institutions make lending simpler, faster, and more efficient. Banks, credit unions, fintechs, and mortgage lenders use Blend to power home lending and consumer banking, with Autopilot increasingly scaling intelligence across the lending lifecycle. In 2025, Blend helped financial institutions process nearly $1.3 trillion in loan applications. Learn more at blend.com.
